lastFailure.message: A zero-sample infrastructure-only profile changed advice from 20000/4000 to the failed task's 10000/2000 token gates.

rootCause.summary: adviseSplit consumed recommended token fields from a profile even when sampleCount was zero and the profile contained only infrastructure diagnostics.
rootCause.reproductionTest: bridge/src/test/split-memory.test.ts: infrastructure failures are recorded without shrinking split advice, with mismatched event and proposed budgets
rootCause.observedFailure: Infrastructure attribution correctly kept sampleCount at zero, but initialProfile copied the failed task budget and adviseSplit treated it as learned advice.
rootCause.nextProof: none; every required stable release gate passed
